g.text: Optimizer ablation: tuned parameters vs the same structure's defaults

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #26343d

g.text: Colored markers retain every generation separately; their intervals are paired 95% demand-path CIs, not generation CIs.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #26343d

g.text: Black diamonds use all 3 generation means. No pooled interval is inferred from per-generation intervals; missing pairs remain missing.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #26343d

g.text: Positive values indicate lower cost after tuning. Tuning gains alone do not establish new-structure discovery.
